description: Numbered steps explaining how your dairy is produced.

heading.default: From our pasture to your fridge in under 12 hours

intro.default: Complete transparency at every step — so you always know exactly where your milk comes from.

default.title: Graze
default.text: Our herd grazes on open, pesticide-free pastures from spring to late autumn.

default.title: Milk
default.text: Gentle, stress-free milking at dawn in our clean, solar-powered parlour.

default.title: Test & Pasteurise
default.text: Lab-tested for purity, then gently pasteurised to lock in taste and nutrients.

default.title: Deliver
default.text: Bottled on the farm and delivered chilled to your door the same morning.
